comment: Recognition layer 2: community/district signs along the Airport-to-Ochi route. Coordinates are real lat/lon, projected into world space via Road.project(). radius = trigger distance in compressed-world meters. needs_owner_review: true = placement derived from map data, not lived knowledge — owner should verify before shipping.

communities.name: Palisadoes
communities.note: The airport strip — sea on both sides, coconut tree-lined

communities.name: Harbour View
communities.note: End of the Palisadoes strip; the roundabout into Kingston

communities.name: Rockfort
communities.note: Industrial area on Windward Road, Kingston Harbour side

communities.name: Vineyard Town
communities.note: Residential community along Mountain View Avenue

communities.name: Wareika Hill
communities.note: Hillside community above Mountain View Ave — Rasta roots

communities.name: Liguanea
communities.note: Commercial hub — banks, shops, restaurants on Hope Road

communities.name: Half Way Tree
communities.note: The commercial heart of uptown Kingston; clock tower, market

communities.name: Duhaney Park
communities.note: Residential community south of Half Way Tree

communities.name: Waterhouse
communities.note: West Kingston community on Spanish Town Road

communities.name: Whitfield Town
communities.note: West Kingston residential community

communities.name: Caymanas

communities.name: Angels

communities.name: Bog Walk

communities.name: Mount Rosser

communities.name: Alexandria

communities.name: Fern Gully

communities.name: Ocho Rios
communities.note: Tourist hub of the north coast — Dunn's River Falls is yours
